Live project

Tourfixer.

A more connected way to explore Uzbekistan.

The idea

Bring private transfers, local guides, and day trips into one place, so travelers can explore their options before a journey.

A journey starts somewhere

Routes between cities, airport transfers, and different vehicle options give the experience a practical starting point.

Local knowledge matters

The platform connects travelers with local guides in places including Samarkand, Bukhara, Khiva, and Tashkent.

Why it belongs in my world

Tourfixer sits right at the intersection of building digital products and my interest in travel tech.
